# crawler-playbook

> Social-media collection and analysis toolkit. Goal: complete, accurate, fresh
> data across platforms, then structured labeling and reports.

## Start here
- AGENTS.md: operating instructions for AI agents (English)
- README.md: overview and quickstart (Chinese)
- config/platforms.yaml: platform → adapter → command → auth → output → gotchas
- config/project.example.yaml: topic, keywords, date window, platform switches, thresholds
- docs/04-runbook.md: copy-paste commands
- docs/07-failure-playbook.md: what to do when a crawl breaks
- docs/05-data-schema.md: normalized / label / showcase / KOL schemas

## Core commands
- python -m pipeline.collect.media_crawler <platform> search|detail
- python -m pipeline.collect.x.search
- python -m pipeline.collect.x.threads
- python -m pipeline.collect.youtube.run
- python -m pipeline.collect.weibo.crawl
- python -m pipeline.collect.wechat.crawl
- python -m pipeline.normalize
- python -m pipeline.audit --strict
- python -m pipeline.label
- python -m pipeline.analyze.metrics
- python -m pipeline.analyze.balanced
- python -m pipeline.video.run --offline
- python -m pipeline.kol.extract
- python -m pipeline.kol.aggregate

## Credentials and accounts
- Xiaohongshu: use a secondary account; main accounts can be rate-limited.
- X: collect cookies with the "Get your cookies" Chrome extension; never ask for passwords.
- Never commit .env, cookies, browser profiles, or raw user data.

## Invariants
- Never commit .env, cookies, browser profiles, raw user data.
- Anonymize only the configured brand and LLM proxy; keep competitors and platforms.
- Do not create a showcase unless the video is a self-tested, same-task, multi-model comparison.
- Run normalize and audit before labeling. Stop if audit fails.
